_doc: MASTRO DE PAJA dating cabinet (#48, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #25). THE Pesaro-school mother house: founded 1972 by Giancarlo Guidi ('Pajetta'); the ownership ladder is the dating spine — Guidi+Spadoni 1972-1981 -> Guidi leaves (-> Ser Jacopo) -> Spadoni + Cecchini -> Spadoni leaves -> Alberto Montini (from ~1983-84; later sole owner). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Mastro_de_Paja.json (company text) + Ser_Jacopo.json + Il_Ceppo.json cross-facts.

history_anchors._doc: 1972: Guidi founds MASTRO DE PAJA (Pesaro); Giannino Spadoni joins shortly after ('Mastro de Paja di Guidi e Spadoni'). 1981: the partnership breaks — GUIDI LEAVES (founds Ser Jacopo 1982, with Bruto Sordini who later founds Don Carlos). Spadoni stays; financial trouble -> TERENZIO CECCHINI becomes majority owner/director; Spadoni then leaves too (founds his own firm). ~1983-84: ALBERTO MONTINI (b. Pesaro, accountant; at his uncle's firm 1978-1983) hired by Cecchini — employee -> administrator -> partner -> SOLE OWNER after Cecchini's death. Montini reset: fewer pipes, higher quality, export pivot (40+ countries; ~2,000/yr today). 2017: 45th-anniversary pipe = Inter-Tabac 'Pipe of the Year'. Classification: LIMITED EDITION / ELITE (all handmade) / CLASSICA. Grade stamps: rusticated 0B (0B Unica), sandblast 1B (+1 Sun), partial 2D (+1 Sun), colored smooth Ruber/Castanea/3A(+Suns), natural smooth 3B/3C(+Suns), F straight grain (+1/2/3 Suns); silver/gold work stamps P/N/L/S/G; sizes Media/Gigante. SUN symbols = grain quality steps.
